guia.intro: Thank you for reviewing Maysa Brain. Everything you see is as students would see it; your part is to say what is right and what you would change. Nothing is published as verified without a teacher's approval.
guia.responder: In each entry, under each field, there are three buttons: Correct, Suggest a fix (write the change, with its source if you have one) and Not my field. You can leave a comment. To remove an answer, press the same button again. If the whole entry is right, "Mark all as correct" answers the fields you have left in one go, without changing the ones you already answered. Each answer is saved automatically in this browser.
guia.quitarSinCanal: If you make a mistake, choose the right verdict; removing a mark is not saved.
guia.idiomas: Fields are reviewed in the language you are viewing: to review the English version, press EN in the header (and ES for the Spanish one); you stay in review mode and on the same entry.
guia.dudas: Some entries carry an "Open question for you": a specific question left by the writing. Answering it helps the most.
guia.nombres: If a name has no official term in Spanish or Latin, the entry shows the proposal and its source: confirm or correct it.
guia.marcadores: Markers are structures without a 3D mesh. If the approximate position is right, press "Correct"; if it is missing or wrong, use "Propose position" and tap the point on the model.
guia.trazos: The vagus branches come as unnamed strands. In "What to review", the "Vagus strands" section opens the first pending one; choose which branch it is (or confirm the audit's proposal), leave a comment if you like and continue with "Next strand". You can also tap a strand on the model.
guia.recorridos: The recurrent laryngeal nerves are not in the model, and in the thorax there is a gap in both vagus nerves (the right one, between the subclavian artery and the main bronchus; the left one stops as it enters the thorax), because the source model mirrors that segment. Those courses are pending tracing and are not reviewed in this session.
guia.vagoCasilla: The vagus strands only appear if you tick "I can also review the course of the vagus nerve in the neck and thorax": when you give your authorization or, whenever you like, in that same checkbox on the review bar (on a phone, inside "Actions").
guia.guardado: You do not have to send anything: each answer is saved automatically to the editor's sheet a few seconds after you mark it, and the review bar says "Saved ✓" once it is saved. If it says "No connection: it will be saved when the connection is back", do nothing: your answers stay on this device and are saved automatically when the connection returns.
guia.otroEquipo: You can continue on another device: open the same link on a computer, tablet or phone and you will see what you have already answered.
guia.privacidad: The first time an answer is about to be saved, the atlas asks once for your authorization to process your data (Colombian Law 1581 of 2012) and whether you can also review the vagus nerve. We do not ask for your name or email, and the entries only say "Reviewed by a university teacher", without any of your data. The proposals and comments you write may be published under your alias (never your name) in the project's public issues, so do not write anything that identifies you.

autorizacion.texto: To save your review, the atlas sends your reviewer code, your answers, the date and time, this authorization and what you tick in the vagus nerve checkbox to the editor's Google sheet. We do not ask for your name or email. The editor uses these data only to review and correct the entries, and the entries never show any of your data. When the editor imports the reviews, your proposals and comments may be published under your reviewer alias (an identifier such as D01, never your name) in the project's public issues on GitHub, so do not write anything that identifies you. Data controller: Maysa Strategy Partners. To access, correct or delete your data, or to withdraw this authorization, write to info@maysasp.com (Colombian Law 1581 of 2012).

privacidad.intro: This notice explains which personal data Maysa Brain processes, why, with which providers, how long they are kept and how to exercise your rights. There are no user accounts and no tracking cookies.
privacidad.responsable: Data controller: Maysa Strategy Partners. For any request about your personal data, write to info@maysasp.com.
privacidad.visitas: We count visits with Cloudflare Web Analytics, without cookies and without storing anything in your browser. On each visit, your browser sends Cloudflare the address of the page you open, the page you came from (referrer), loading times and some page performance metrics. Cloudflare also processes your IP address and your browser's user agent (which browser and system you use). This counting is not loaded on pages you open in review mode or while your browser remembers your code. An atlas page that was already open before you opened your review link may send its count, including when you close or reload it.
privacidad.alojamiento: The site is hosted on GitHub Pages. Like any web server, GitHub receives your IP address and your browser's user agent to deliver the pages and the 3D model.
privacidad.revision: If you review entries with a personal review link, the atlas sends the editor's Google sheet your reviewer code, your answers (verdicts, proposals and comments), the date and time of each one, your authorization with the version of the text you accepted and what you tick in the vagus nerve checkbox. We do not ask for your name or email. The entries only say "Reviewed by a university teacher", without any of your data.
privacidad.respaldo: If automatic saving does not respond for several minutes, the atlas may offer to send the same answers through a Google form of the editor. The form is a Google site and follows Google's terms.
privacidad.publicacion: To prepare corrections, the editor publishes a summary of the reviews in the project's public issues on GitHub. There, your proposals and comments appear under your reviewer alias, never with your code or your name, so do not write anything that identifies you.
privacidad.reportes: You can report an error in an entry in two ways, and the app does not save either report: it only builds the link and your browser opens it. If you choose GitHub, GitHub's form opens already filled in; when you send it with your account, it becomes a public issue in the project's repository, with your GitHub username and what you write; anyone can read it, so do not write personal data. If you choose email, the message leaves from your email program and reaches info@maysasp.com with your email address; the editor uses it only to correct the atlas and reply to you. To ask for a report to be deleted, write to info@maysasp.com.
privacidad.finalidades: Analytics tells us how many people use the atlas and what to improve. Teacher review data are used only to review and correct the entries and to show you the vagus nerve courses if you ticked that checkbox.
privacidad.base: Analytics is based on the controller's legitimate interest in knowing how many people use the atlas. Teacher review is based on the authorization you give once inside the atlas (Colombian Law 1581 of 2012), and you can withdraw it at any time.
privacidad.proveedoresTitulo: Providers and where they process data
privacidad.proveedorGoogle: Google: spreadsheet, script and form for teacher review.
privacidad.proveedorGithub: GitHub: site hosting (GitHub Pages) and the project's public issues.
privacidad.transferencia: All three are United States companies and may process these data in the United States and in other countries where they have servers. If you visit from outside the United States, this means an international transfer of your data.
privacidad.conservacionRevision: Rows in the review sheet are kept until you ask for them to be deleted. Your proposals and comments in the public issues stay there until you ask for them to be removed; whatever has already been incorporated into the entries stays in the project's public history.
privacidad.conservacionProveedores: Cloudflare and GitHub keep analytics and hosting data according to their own policies.
privacidad.derechos: You can ask to access, correct or delete your data, object to their processing or withdraw your authorization by writing to info@maysasp.com. If you are a teacher, do not put your reviewer code in the message: the editor identifies you through the channel used to invite you.
privacidad.autoridad: You can also lodge a complaint with the data protection authority of your country; in Colombia it is the Superintendencia de Industria y Comercio.
privacidad.cookiesTitulo: Cookies and storage in your browser
privacidad.cookies: The atlas does not create cookies and uses no tracking cookies. What it remembers in your browser (for example, the chosen theme, that you already saw the first notice and, in review mode, your code and your answers in progress) is kept only in that browser and is deleted when you clear the site's data.

recorrido.nota: Simplified model of the pathway. The nerve is drawn down to the current stop; each text comes from the structure entry, with its sources.
recorrido.notaToracico: In the thorax the atlas leaves a gap in both vagus nerves: that segment is pending tracing.
recorrido.notaIzquierdo: From here the right vagus is followed: in the atlas, the left one stops as it enters the thorax and its course to the abdomen is pending tracing.

cortes.aviso: The model comes from a single body, not from MRI scans: slices help you get oriented but do not replace a neuroimaging atlas.
cortes.sinModelo: Slices are available once the 3D model has loaded.
cortes.rellenoApagado: Your device stayed below 30 frames per second with slices on, so the fill was turned off and only the outline is shown.
cortes.fantasmaAyuda: Shows the side removed by the cut, faintly.

origen.aviso: Approximate tracing for teaching. The overall position follows the cited source; calibre and exact course vary between people.
origen.toracico: Gap in the thorax: one segment of each vagus nerve is pending tracing.
origen.huecoFicha: In the atlas, a thoracic segment of this nerve is pending tracing: in the right vagus, between the subclavian artery and the main bronchus; the left vagus stops as it enters the thorax. The source model mirrors that segment from one side to the other, with relations that do not match, so a gap is left.
